resources.name: Bahnhofsmission Germany
resources.summary: A nationwide finder for station missions offering immediate help without registration, including food, drink, clothing, first aid, a safe place, travel assistance, and local referrals.
resources.availabilityNote: Opening hours differ by station. Use the official finder to choose a location and check its current hours.
resources.sourceDetail: The official network and Deutsche Bahn describe immediate, free help and provide locations and opening hours for station missions.

resources.costNote: Free to search; provider rules vary
resources.name: Tafel Germany Finder
resources.summary: The official search for local Tafel food banks distributing rescued food to people experiencing poverty.
resources.availabilityNote: Local Tafeln set their own proof, registration, schedules, and capacity rules. Search by town or postal code and contact the location first.
resources.sourceDetail: Tafel Deutschland reports more than 980 local Tafeln and provides a location search.
resources.coverageNote: More than 980 food banks across Germany.

resources.name: Berliner Kältehilfe
resources.costNote: The service is free of charge for people who have no place of their own and cannot afford accommodation.
resources.summary: Berliner Kältehilfe provides emergency overnight accommodation, warm meals, and medical help for homeless people in Berlin during the cold season. The service aims to prevent people without shelter from freezing to death.
resources.availabilityNote: The cold relief season lasts from October to April. Emergency overnight stays are generally open every evening during this period.
resources.sourceName: Senatsverwaltung für Soziales, Berliner Kirchengemeinden, Wohlfahrtsverbände
resources.sourceKind: Official service locator or guidance page
resources.sourceDetail: The official Berlin.de page confirms the Berliner Kältehilfe provides unbureaucratic overnight accommodation during the cold season for homeless people.
resources.verifiedQuote: Als niedrigschwelliges Angebot soll es Menschen, die keine eigene Bleibe haben und sich keine Unterkunft leisten können, vor dem Erfrieren bewahren.
resources.coverageNote: Coverage area: Berlin, Germany. The map marker is geographic context, not a single service address.
